user.title: Select Setup Mode
user.description: Choose how you want to configure your Atomberg Smart Lock.

menu_option_descriptions.cloud: Import lock credentials automatically from your Atomberg app account (supports Email, Google, Apple, or Facebook).
menu_option_descriptions.manual: Configure the lock using an existing Bluetooth MAC address, Master Key, and Lock Salt.

cloud.title: Atomberg Cloud Account Sync
cloud.description:
Authenticate with your Atomberg account to import your smart locks:

1. **[Log in to Atomberg]({auth_url})** *(opens in a new tab)*.
2. Sign in with Email, Google, Apple, or Facebook.
3. After signing in, your browser redirects to a page containing `?code=...`.
4. Copy the complete address from your browser's address bar and paste it below.

data_description.auth_code: Paste the complete redirected URL (containing ?code=...) or the authorization code.

manual.title: Manual Key Entry
manual.description: Enter your lock's Bluetooth MAC address, 16-byte Master Key, and 4-byte Lock Salt.

error.cloud_sync_failed: Failed to retrieve lock credentials from Atomberg account.
error.no_locks_found: No smart locks were found associated with this Atomberg account.

abort.already_configured: This Atomberg lock is already configured.

init.title: Select Credential Slot
init.description: Select an enrolled credential slot from the dropdown to assign or update its name, or choose **Add Custom Slot Number...** to configure a specific slot.

data_description.slot_id: Select a discovered fingerprint, NFC card, or PIN slot to configure.

edit_slot.title: Configure Slot {slot_id}
edit_slot.description: Enter the display name for credential slot **{slot_id}** (e.g. 'Selva Right Thumb' or 'Guest NFC Card'). Leave blank to remove.

data_description.name: Display name used for this credential in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_slot: Please enter a valid slot number between 1 and 65534.
